scope: Local synthetic maintenance/water-supply private evidence only; no recipient/public media, automatic validation or publication.

compatibility.routing: Only this exact source-allowlisted contract hash selects Linux, before Windows artifact checks. Unknown/substituted hashes refuse. Existing Windows branch stays closed.
compatibility.isolation_profile_sha256: SHA256 of canonical closed runtime descriptor; no path, tag, caller flags or default platform.
compatibility.models: No model, retained migration, original/capture/coordinate, historical provenance or recipient serializer change.
compatibility.scanner_versions: Common clamav_version stays upstream numeric1.4.6; artifact display/build provenance and exported strict ABI explicitly identify derived1.4.6-kapit-strict1. Never represent locally modified binary as unmodified official binary.

descriptor.types: schema exact int1; execution_platform exact string above; image_id sha256: plus64 lowercase hex; strict_scan_abi cl_kapit_scanmap_strict_v1; all remaining fields lowercase64hex SHA256. Reject booleans, duplicate/unknown/nonfinite fields, malformed UTF8, excessive depth/nodes and trailing JSON.
descriptor.canonicalization: UTF8 JSON sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii true, no trailing newline.
descriptor.bindings: image_id is exact daemon-observed immutable Linux amd64 identity (containerd may expose the platform manifest digest rather than configuration blob digest). oci_manifest_sha256 independently binds exact platform OCI manifest, configuration blob and ordered layer digests; never a multiarchitecture index alone. All manifest/config/layer identities and platform must match verified acquired closure and actual daemon image. closure_inventory_sha256 separately binds complete loader/libc/ELF/transitive libraries/Python/stdlib/Pillow codecs/helpers/notices. Build provenance binds original signed source, exact strict patch, immutable builder/toolchain/offline dependency inputs, runtime base and final output. No Windows receipts or bare version strings.
descriptor.proof_binding_sha256: Canonical SHA256 of the closed pre-proof context below; never the final proof/descriptor/contract hash. Final authenticated proof separately binds the full descriptor and contract hashes. This avoids circular hashing.

confinement: Fresh one-request PID1 uid/gid65532, no capabilities, no_new_privs, one thread; read-only root, private namespaces, no network, mounts/volumes/daemon socket/host paths or image healthcheck. Explicit local named-pipe daemon only, no pull. No inherited descriptors except verified anonymous input/output/error pipes and checked O_PATH scratch directory during setup.

Explicit install_abi3_confinement uses filesystem-only Landlock ruleset through REFER and TRUNCATE; ABI>=3 required. Only exact no-follow scratch tmpfs grants regular file/directory writes, create/remove/refer/truncate. No filesystem execute or device/socket/FIFO/symlink creation grants.

Mandatory immutable amd64/x32-closed default-deny post-init seccomp globally denies ioctl, socket/network, process/exec, mount/namespace, IPC, memfd/io_uring, process handles, ptrace, privilege/policy changes. Get-only self prlimit64 validates both64bit argument halves. Missing ABI4 network and ABI5 ioctl rights are compensated only by these independently proven stronger restrictions.

Import/init/warmup only trusted fixed public bytes before confinement. Close all transient handles/threads before installing Landlock and seccomp. No private header/stdin byte before successful controls and fixed bounded READY. Do not relax controls for lazy initialization failures.

Actual same-image/kernel escape proof must test existing proc/device/outside writable targets, unexpected/preopened FDs, architecture/x32/network/process/IPC/namespace bypasses, hard byte/inode/resource limits and exact-ID cleanup. ENOENT-only attempts and JSON PASS fields are insufficient.
pipeline: Capture immutable current manifest and checked artifacts under existing cross-process fence; release fence before native work. Exactly three fresh single-purpose workers: entire original scan, bounded decode/metadata stripping to new PNG, entire derivative scan.

Fixed bounded single frame/EOF protocol only; send image bytes, MIME and transient nonce, never source/account/revision IDs, coordinates object, keys, database credentials, host paths, filenames or arbitrary argv. READY is trusted child installation evidence combined with pinned parent-owned configuration and independent actual proof, never standalone authority.

Scanner initializes pinned locally derived ClamAV1.4.6-kapit-strict1, verified immutable main/daily/bytecode CVDs and fixed limits before input. Strict exported ABI must preserve every relevant parse/map/I/O/bytecode/limit/timeout/cleanup error and prove full root buffer coverage/completion. Unknown/nonclean/partial/unsupported result refuses; no callback or upstream return0 alone establishes clean.

Decoder pinned Pillow13.0.0 Linux cp314 wheel; fixed JPEG/PNG plugins, one frame and bounded dimensions/pixels. Apply orientation, construct new pixels, remove metadata. Independently parse returned strict normalized PNG and scan it with a distinct fresh scanner.

Drain both streams with independent byte/wall limits; suppress raw native diagnostics. Never put image bytes/metadata in argv, Docker labels/build/logs, reports or receipts. Stop/reap CLI and independently stop/remove/verify absent exact owned container ID. Unknown ID never permits name adoption. Cleanup uncertainty overrides success.

After all phases, reacquire current fence before business locks; recheck current authority, immutable source/revision, manifest/generation/expiry and audit, then immutable private commit. Existing processing orchestration remains authoritative. Failures keep quarantine private.
proof_and_currentness: Closed authenticated proof issued only by fixed operator coordinator after executing actual same-image confinement/native/failure tests outside database locks and manifest fence. No sign-arbitrary-JSON/PASS flag/test callback. Dedicated protected proof key absent from workers; protected pinned verification key and strict receipt binding required. Exact issuer/key bootstrap/rotation implementation needs independent review before activation.

Proof binds contract/descriptor/image/helper/filter/options/limits/strict patch/signature generation, exact tested kernel/daemon, probe source and actual bounded observation/expiry. Proof authenticity certifies immutable tested configuration, not perpetual daemon liveness. Each new native call independently verifies live daemon/image/control installation. Runtime/policy change requires fenced revocation.

_load/current_tools/assert_current/private retrieval perform only bounded local immutable artifact/authentication/freshness/highwater checks; no Docker/compiler/scanner/decoder/probe in database or fence. Missing/stale/tampered/revoked artifacts or proof refuse. Historical immutable provenance does not confer current delivery eligibility.

Separate official updater with public-network access and no project input verifies signatures/checks actual engine compatibility, then publishes exclusively created immutable generation. No worker updates/downloads; no active mutation, fabricated check timestamps, rollback or clock reversal. Existing protected fence, dirty marker, monotonic generation/time and highwater-first activation retained.

Trusted host operator, kernel, Docker daemon/VM and equivalent host-owner processes remain inside trust boundary. Receipt signatures do not prevent malicious same-owner key/file replacement. No forensic erasure claim for host memory/paging.
activation_gates: Actual successful confinement and all escape/resource/cleanup tests
Complete pinned offline native build and dependency inventory
Strict complete clean and detection/error/limit/malformed native fixtures
authorization: Existing explicit approved local container approach and latest implement; phone deferred, no global runtime/kernel changes, cloud, production, paid resources or retained migration. No gate is implied by this contract file.

proof_context.types: schema exact int1; execution_platform exact named platform; kernel_release and daemon_engine_version nonempty ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._+-] strings <=128 characters; remaining fields lowercase64hex SHA256. Same strict JSON and canonicalization as descriptor.
proof_context.acyclic: Context excludes contract/descriptor/final proof hashes and receipt/signature. Final closed authenticated proof binds context hash, contract hash, descriptor hash, exact observed successful suite evidence hash and observed/expiry UTC timestamps. Proof issuer implementation must freeze the exact final schema before activation.

proof_schema.types: schema exact int1; purpose/platform exact strings; every SHA256 lowercase64hex; observed_at/valid_until exact calendar-valid UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; signature canonical unpadded URL-safe base64 of exactly64 Ed25519 signature bytes (86 characters). Reject duplicates, nonfinite, booleans, unknown fields, bad UTF8, depth>8/nodes>2048 and bytes>16384.
proof_schema.signed_bytes: ASCII KAPIT-C2:private-evidence-linux-native-proof-v1 followed by one zero byte, then canonical UTF8 JSON of the full closed proof object EXCLUDING signature (sorted keys, comma/colon separators, ensure_ascii true). No generic signing command or caller-selected purpose/context.
proof_schema.acyclic: Construct fixed context; descriptor binds only context hash. Construct generic manifest binding descriptor. Then final signed proof binds context, descriptor, contract, full manifest and completed native-suite evidence hashes. None of context/descriptor/manifest includes final proof bytes/hash/signature. Image/runtime.json excludes all final image/descriptor/proof self-hashes.
proof_schema.key: Exactly32-byte Ed25519 raw public key, SHA256 matching closed context and signed proof; trusted source is protected operator verifier configuration, never a request/receipt-supplied key. Operator private key remains outside workers/builds, exclusively bootstrapped/pinned/rotated under separately reviewed fixed issuer workflow. Signatures alone do not establish caller key authority or runtime safety.
proof_schema.time: observed_at is actual completed native-suite observation, never future; observed_at < valid_until <= observed_at+86400 seconds, and proof expiry cannot exceed current manifest or verified signature/update bounds. Existing cross-process monotonic clock/generation highwater and revocation remain mandatory. No mtime/date-only refresh.
proof_schema.suite: required_suite_sha256 must equal context and the fixed reviewed native coordinator source-defined required suite. observed_suite_sha256 binds bounded closed actual completed same-final-image native evidence, purpose distinct from PUBLIC_ABI3_ONLY. Every required positive/denial/nonclean/failure/resource/cleanup case must have its exact expected actual outcome. No copied public-base receipt, fixture PASS callback, arbitrary result dictionary or source-only test qualifies.
proof_schema.activation_separation: Native proof issuance follows actual same-image tool/isolation/strict-completion fixtures outside DB/fence. API/currentness/audit/regression and independent final review are additional activation gates, not claimed by native proof; this avoids requiring an active proof in order to issue it. No GET/_load starts a probe.
